sequences.source: TCIA CT COLONOGRAPHY (ACRIN 6664), second supine scan; colon mask from HQColon (radiologist-checked)

zone.label: ACRIN record · slice 353 ±10
zone.note: ACRIN records a 18 mm polyp at supine slice 353. Yellow: every wall within ±10 slices (±8 mm). The slice numbering was checked against this patient's own CT, so the band sits where ACRIN says.

polyp.label: polyp candidate · slice #348, 16–17 mm
polyp.note: Found blind by surface shape (cap), in both supine scans at the same spot, inside ACRIN's slice band; soft-tissue density (~70 HU), no tagging, no gas bubbles; ~16–17 mm by volume vs 18 mm recorded. Not yet confirmed by a radiologist.

polyp.label: cap candidate · slice #257, 19.7 mm
polyp.note: Top-ranked of 7 cap-shaped clusters found by a BLIND scan of the whole colon — no hint from ACRIN's record. It lands on slice 257, exactly the prone slice ACRIN gives for a 20 mm polyp, and measures 19.7 mm across. ⚠ Shape only: without the patient's CT there is no density check, so stool cannot be excluded. Not confirmed by a radiologist. The same patient's supine scan has no candidate anywhere near this band.
